{{# Single text + phonetic-text pair inside the PersonName composite. Caller provides: handle — parent field handle (the form's composite key) subfield — the subfield key under the parent (first_name etc.) label — translated label for the text input autocomplete — HTML autocomplete value for the text input pair_value — the resolved subfield value (the caller does value.first_name etc. so the partial doesn't have to compute dynamic paths) require_text — boolean, parent's require_text config require_phonetic — boolean, parent's require_phonetic config parent_required — boolean, parent's `validate: required` hide_when_flag — optional, name of the scope-flag that hides this pair via Alpine `x-show` (e.g. "no_middle_name"). When set, the `required` attribute becomes Alpine-bound so the browser doesn't block submit on a field the user can't see. Always-visible pairs (first_name, last_name) leave it unset. Required-attr semantics match PersonName::extraRules(): - text inputs are `required` when (parent_required OR require_text) — the same `$mustText = $required || $requireText` logic that the server-side rules use (see PersonName::mergeTextRules). - phonetic_text inputs are `required` only when require_phonetic is true (independent of parent_required) — see mergePhoneticRules. Submission shape: `name="{handle}[{subfield}][text]"` / `[phonetic_text]`. Each input also binds `x-model` to the exact nested scope path (`..text` / `.phonetic_text`). This is targeted — nothing like the parent-clobbering `x-model="form."` that Statamic's Alpine driver emits by default and that UAMS-Web/uams-statamic-archive#670 dropped for composites. The targeted binding writes to the right nested slot, so the public-form Alpine engines (calculation_*, person-name display_format, field-conditions referencing composite subfields) see name part edits reactively. #}} {{# `???` keeps a literal `false` instead of falling through to the default, unlike `??`. See person_name.antlers.html for the same workaround. #}} {{ row_required_text = parent_required || ( require_text ??? true ) }} {{ row_required_phonetic = ( require_phonetic ??? false ) }}
